ConversationID.description: This is a global unique Identifier of the request

ResponseCode.description: This is a numeric status code that indicates the status of the transaction processing. 0 means successful processing and any other code means an error occured or the transaction failed

ResponseMessage.description: Response Message is a message from the API that gives the status of the request processing, usualy maps to a specific ResultCode value. It can be a Success processing message or an error description message

DetailedMessage.description: This is used to give a more detailed message about the Validated Agent

OrganizationShortCode.description: Displays the Organizaion Shortcode. Displayed when the request is successfull and the identifiertype provided is 4 TillNumber -Displays the Till Number. Displayed when the request is successfull and the identifiertype provided is 2

OrganizationName.description: This is the name of the store registered under the given paybill/till number. It is only returned for Successful request

ChargeProfileID.description: Displays the profile of the charged id. Displayed when the request is successfull
